subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight details are as follows: - Departure: [Date] at [Time] from [Airport] - Arrival: [Date] at [Time] at Charles de Gaulle Airport Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you onboard! Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
